idea: 61 trained validation vectors from previously rejected branches sit unused in work/. Each was rejected on its own. They have never been screened against the CURRENT 27-column pool, and never as a joint block.
honest_risk: This is a sweep over 61 candidates on the same fold-378 data that rejected most of them. Without a correction the maximum of 61 noisy statistics is guaranteed to look like a finding. The correction is therefore fixed before the sweep runs.

selection_correction.expected_maximum_bias: sigma * sqrt(2 ln 61) = 2.87 sigma; with the measured standard error of about 1.2e-05 this is 3.4e-05
selection_correction.components: 0.00008 standing magnitude + 0.00004 standard adaptive charge + 0.000035 maximum-of-61 selection bias
selection_correction.correlation_with_stack: at least 0.99, since 155-159 showed the moment recovery is only safe there and these are all model predictions so they should satisfy it naturally

joint_rule.block: ALL individually passing candidates, in one block. No subset search after seeing the joint number.
joint_rule.threshold: joint gain >= 2 * added_df * 0.0000395 + 0.00004 + 0.000035, the project's own strict formula plus the same two charges
joint_rule.note: if no candidate passes individually, no joint block is formed; fishing for a subset that works jointly is exactly the winner's curse that FINDINGS 2.2 rejected

expected_outcome: most likely nothing passes; these branches were rejected for reasons that the current pool, which is strictly stronger than the pool they were rejected against, will not reverse
